title: Tag filtering is case-insensitive
description: Extend notes list tag filtering so a query of 'WORK' matches a note tagged 'work'. Preserve the existing behavior that archived notes remain hidden unless include_archived=True, and do not change the list_notes return type.
pass_condition: Full existing test suite still passes AND tasks/hidden_tests/adversarial/test_adv_nc_01.py passes.

title: Reject unknown item sort fields
description: GET /items?sort_by=<value> must return 400 Bad Request for any value other than 'name' or 'price'. Valid sort fields must keep their existing ascending behavior and the response must remain JSON.
pass_condition: Full existing test suite still passes AND tasks/hidden_tests/adversarial/test_adv_inv_01.py passes.

title: Restock rejects non-positive amounts
description: POST /items/{id}/restock must reject zero, negative, boolean, and non-integer amounts with 400 Bad Request without changing the stored quantity. Positive integers must retain the existing 200 response and increment behavior.
pass_condition: Full existing test suite still passes AND tasks/hidden_tests/adversarial/test_adv_inv_02.py passes.

title: Top-N ties are deterministic
description: Update top_n_products so products are ordered by net revenue descending, then product name ascending when net revenue ties. Keep the return type as a list of (product, net_revenue) tuples.
pass_condition: Full existing test suite still passes AND tasks/hidden_tests/adversarial/test_adv_sr_01.py passes.

title: Date-range arguments are validated
description: The sales-report CLI must reject malformed --start/--end dates and reject a range where start is after end with a non-zero exit. Valid ISO dates remain inclusive and keep the existing report output.
pass_condition: Full existing test suite still passes AND tasks/hidden_tests/adversarial/test_adv_sr_02.py passes.

title: Reject unknown transaction types
description: The CSV loader must raise ValueError with a useful message when a transaction type is neither 'sale' nor 'refund'. Valid rows must load unchanged and existing aggregation behavior must remain intact.
pass_condition: Full existing test suite still passes AND tasks/hidden_tests/adversarial/test_adv_sr_03.py passes.
